item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 09/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China in the next few days. The weather will be generally fine over the region. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to bring cool weather to the coastal areas of southern China early next week. With the monsoon moderating gradually midweek next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly.
